profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: There’s a creative side to everything we do—how we live, how we connect with others, and how we solve problems. I enjoy taking the time to really think through challenges and find solutions that are not just effective, but thoughtful and efficient. For me, web development is a great outlet for that kind of creativity. I’m passionate about building applications that solve real problems and make a meaningful impact on people’s lives. I do my best work with teams and individuals who are motivated to go the extra mile and create products that genuinely improve the customer experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•      Developed scalable, user-centered front-end applications and digital platforms with a focus on performance and usability. 
•      Demonstrated end-to-end expertise in the UI development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, implementation, testing, debugging, and optimization. 
•      Proficient in Angular (v14+), TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3 for building modern web applications. 
•      Designed and integrated RESTful APIs, applying best practices in API architecture and data handling. 
•      Implemented and supported automation processes, including testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines, to improve development efficiency and reliability. 
•      Delivered high-quality software in fast-paced agile environments, with releases ranging from biweekly deployments to daily updates. 
•      Built resilient, maintainable, and high-performance software systems aligned with business and user needs. 
•      Took ownership of deliverables, consistently driving projects to successful completion with strong accountability and results orientation. 
•      Collaborated effectively with cross-functional teams across multiple geographic regions to deliver cohesive solutions. 
•      Authored and maintained clear technical documentation in Confluence to support team knowledge sharing and onboarding. 
•      Utilized licensed GitHub Copilot to automate repetitive code generation, significantly reducing development time for new features. 
•      Applied prompt engineering techniques with large language models (LLMs) to accelerate prototyping and reduce solution discovery time by up to 37%.
positions.insights: Skills: Angular 15+ · TypeScript · NestJS · Node.js · Unit Testing · Swagger API · Microsoft Visual Studio Code · GitHub · Jira · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Figma · Miro Collaboration Platform · Confluence · Project Coordination · Project Delivery · Team Coordination · Team Building · Salesforce Lightning · macOS · GitHub Copilot

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.locationName: Farmers Branch, Texas, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
•	Worked on 10-person team as a Frontend UI developer to create and manage an application with custom features used by a fortune 500 company.

•	Collaborated in a strong teamwork centered, hybrid work environment creating application components using: Angular 15, JavaScript, Typescript, SASS, CSS3, HTML5, other minor libraries such as: Storybook, Angular Material, Nx, and Redux. Used NgRx to manage reactive state management in the application.

•	Collaborated with API developers for API design planning, database creation, and API management using .NET framework and SQL Server. Used Postman and Swagger for API testing and code generation.

•	Analyzed business requirements and Figma designs for each project to make recommendations and write technical specifications on how to best translate them into actionable plans in line with job expectations, using Jira and Confluence.

•	Created user stories and documentation in an agile, fast paced environment using Jira, confluence, Miro, story decomp sessions, and strong communication skills to discuss design and function changes under tight deadlines; often having to learn new skills and technologies on the fly, when necessary.

•	Production management, development, and testing was completed during 2-week sprints using Microsoft Azure DevOps, and Jira for reporting.

•	Efficiently communicated with and motivated teammates using collaboration tools such as Jira, Microsoft Teams, Miro, Figma, and Confluence for communication and file sharing.

•	Periodically lead design sessions with UI/UX to discuss upcoming project designs, application usability, client requests, and any design conflicts encountered visually in the application due to technology constraints.

•	Collaborated with QA to execute end-to-end testing for application in browser using Playwright.
positions.insights: Skills: Angular 15+ · TypeScript · Software Design · Project Coordination · Team Coordination · Team Building · User Experience Design (UED) · Project Delivery · Azure DevOps · Jira · Figma · NgRx

positions.title: UI Developer
positions.description:
•	Worked as a Front-end UI developer, part of a 6 person team, responsible with building the company a new investment management and visualization application from the ground up.

•	Completed tasks in a teamwork centered environment to create UI components using Angular 7, JavaScript, Typescript, SASS, CSS3, HTML5, other minor libraries, and used NgRx to manage reactive state management in the application.

•	Collaborated with backend developers for design planning, database creation, and API management using .NET framework 4.0, and SQL Server 2017.

•	Completed user stories in a fast-paced environment using strong communication skills and planning sessions to discuss design and function changes under tight deadlines when necessary, using the CI/CD pipeline; often having to learn new skills and technologies on the fly.

•	Production management and testing was completed using the Agile processes, for realistic timelines and manageable workloads, over 2 week sprints using Microsoft TFS for reporting.

•	Managed bi-weekly nightly builds to production using the Salesforce ticketing system and collaborations with Microsoft engineers.

•	Experience using collaboration tools such as Slack and Microsoft Teams for communication and file sharing between team mates.

positions.title: Web Development Mentor
positions.description:
•	Assisted and worked with students as they learned full stack web development, which included ReactJS, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, Nodejs, and SQL.

•	Worked in a fast paced, time constrained environment, making sure that each student received the assistance and care needed for their specific situations using problem solving through brain storming sessions.

•	Built strong relationships and trust with each student through constant collaboration, clear communication, and empathy.

•	Actively monitored student success by taking daily attendance, grading assignments, and reviewing student projects.

•	Handled various roles as mentor to help students achieve their career goals by answering their questions, pair programming with students, reviewing code, and helping students stay motivated.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Converted from AngularJS and learned Angular 5 in a time span of two weeks.

•	Work closely with architects, analysts, and staff to create new products while maintaining current systems.

•	Produce detailed specifications and writing of program code while also preparing training manuals for users.

•	Product development and production testing; presenting ideas for system improvements.

•	Sole Front-end developer responsible for the creation of company’s minimal viable products.

•	Creation of company’s main framework and maintenance.

•	Present application walkthroughs created from main framework to clients.

positions.title: Web Development Mentor
positions.description:
•	Assisted and worked with students as they learned full stack web development, which included HTML/CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, AngularJS, Nodejs, and SQL.

•	Weekly one on ones with students to address concerns, answer questions about subjects that they didn’t understand from lectures, and constant encouragement to keep up their morale.

•	Handled various roles as a mentor to help students achieve their goals by working closely with the instructor, pair programming with students, reviewing code, and reiterating daily lessons with interactive practice.

positions.title: Foreclosure Specialist
positions.description:
•	Responsible for timely processing of activities & responsiveness of alerts to ensure Foreclosure Timeline Management is met.

•	Minimized losses through management of attorney to ensure Foreclosure process is consistently progressing.

•	Ensured accounts are properly documented with actions taken, correspondence, and explanation of delay, if any. Ensure compliance with all state and investor requirements.

•	Negotiated any opportunities to shorten timeline, drive performance, or minimize loss.

•	Individual portfolio management included Following up with other departments and/or local counsel for outstanding items and providing information and chronologies for investor requested reporting.

•	Consistently met requirements and goals set forth for turn-over ratio, FNMA timeline completion, milestone tracking exceptions, avoidable delays, and pull through rate.

•	Reviewed open files as they were received, proof data entered against source documents; made appropriate corrections.

•	Conduct a complete review of the foreclosure file to ensure all default time frames have been met.

•	Manages foreclosure proceedings on assigned cases by interacting and instructing various parties such as mortgagors, attorneys, investors, insurers, Realtors, appraisers and any other party involved with the foreclosure. 
•	Assists other Foreclosure Specialists and acts as a back-up when others are out of the office.

•	Requests, follows up and reviews in detail all appraisals and BPO’s for accuracy to determine the value of the property for the foreclosure sale, calculation of loss analysis, establishment of deficiency judgments, payments of advances, and/or recovery situations. 

•	Upon request, provides the attorney with accurate foreclosure figures, including reinstatement, payoff, and assumption figures which will be provided to external parties by the attorney. In addition, provide the attorney with accurately executed documents as requested.

positions.title: Admissions Advisor
positions.description:
•	Actively promoted and communicated all programs offered at National American University to prospective students. 
•	Conducted personal interviews, telephone interviews and e-mail correspondence to identify student prospects to determine their educational needs, concerns and interests.
•	Responsible for guiding students starting from inquiry through evaluation and acceptance into National American University.
•	Responsible for developing, managing and meeting action plans in order to obtain personal and departmental enrollment objectives.
•	Develop a rapport with prospective students and maintain contact with them frequently.
•	Use the customer relationship management (CRM) system to document all communication with the prospective student.
•	Evaluated monthly activity against standards and personal inquiry goals.
•	Assisted and participated in the planning of recruiting and enrollment events as needed.
•	Ensured compliance with applicable University policies and procedures.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description:
•	Organized classroom plans for individual student group tutorials
•	Responsible for being group mediator and keeping students on task
•	Taught and guided students through learning processes and developing problem solving skills
•	Responsible for creating and designing creative, engaging material that would motivate and stimulate student learning processes.
•	Responsible for managing and teaching classes of twenty plus high school students at a moment’s notice.

projects.title: Logic Keepers home website creation and maintenance
projects.description: This website was a complete makeover of the previous one, which had to be completely redone from scratch. The main problem that had to be solved was how to present all of the technical information that was cluttering the old site, and make the content more organized, easy to read, and the design more appealing. The content was rewritten and a basic mock-up of the entire site was created using the Mockflow software. Once the content and wire frame were approved, I built the website using Bootstrap 4 in combination with basic HTML and CSS. Though the website was originally created with the Angular 4 CLI, it was removed, since most of the website functionality was static. The website took about 3 weeks to complete from conception to website launch. This project is ongoing since I'm responsible for new feature additions while also managing website content and updates.

projects.title: Logic Keepers’ company main framework creation and maintenance
projects.description: This project was created under a NDA, for the company’s minimal viable products, product development, and production testing. Framework created using Angular 5 framework, HTML, CSS, PostgreSQL, Play Framework, HTML, CSS.  I worked in collaboration with architects to create the content, wire frames, and all front-end functionality. The Play Framework (Lightbend) is used for the back-end/services and RESTful API. I created features such as authentication, user registration, admin and member dashboards. I'm also tasked with creating use case production builds for testing and client demos. This project is ongoing as I'm responsible for new feature additions while also managing content and framework updates.
